record_adapter: Parse the committed standardized CSV bytes with Python csv.DictReader; use the single committed target column as label; preserve every other column as an exact textual feature in original header order; preserve missing tokens; reject duplicate headers, missing target columns, row-width errors, empty labels, hash mismatches, byte-length mismatches, and metadata row/feature-count mismatches.
unchanged_components: v0.60 conditioned-cell traversal and structural ranking
repair_policy: Only parser defects may be repaired after record access. Dataset identities, committed CSV hashes and lengths, target columns, representation, selectors, seeds, solvers, budgets, and scientific thresholds may not change.
claim_boundary: A pass is clean preregistered external-data evidence for the frozen v0.72 label-free exact-search mechanism with independent Rust replay. It is not outside-human reproduction, publication novelty, peer review, acceptance, or a world-level/world-first breakthrough.
